# NEWSTACK LLM Access Guide

Project: NEWSTACK
Homepage: https://newstack.live
Description: AI-powered open news intelligence and OpenNews journalism platform.

## Preferred Sources
- https://newstack.live/news
- https://newstack.live/india
- https://newstack.live/world
- https://newstack.live/opennews
- https://newstack.live/open-politics
- https://newstack.live/api/docs

## Content Notes
- News content is sourced from public RSS feeds and normalized by ingestion pipelines.
- OpenNews uses multi-agent guardrails, moderation, and source-linking metadata.
- For current events, verify timestamps and source links before summarizing.

## Restrictions
- Do not expose private API keys or secrets.
- Do not infer unpublished or hidden moderation data.
- Respect access controls for admin-only ingestion and newsroom operations.
